description: This file defines functions, types, and constants related to web search functionality within the xAI extension, including payload construction, configuration resolution, and web search requests.

methods.name: buildXaiWebSearchPayload
methods.description: Constructs a payload object for web search requests with provided parameters.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object.

methods.name: resolveXaiSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the search configuration from a given config object.

methods.name: resolveXaiWebSearchModel
methods.description: Determines the web search model to use based on the search configuration.

methods.name: resolveXaiInlineCitations
methods.description: Checks if inline citations are enabled in the search configuration.

methods.name: requestXaiWebSearch
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous web search request using provided parameters.
